brief:
Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of Hamas, released new video footage of former commander Izz al-Din al-Haddad, according to Shehab Wire. The material was distributed as part of "Storm Islands," a video series that documents the lives and operations of commanders and fighters killed during the conflict.

The video series has become a regular channel through which the group memorializes its fallen leadership and combatants. Previous installments in the "Storm Islands" collection have featured other slain commanders and fighters, with each episode presenting biographical and operational material related to individuals who died during fighting.
